evidence.detail: The only exact-v308 construction site is the custom rs/gui/b SubstanceSkin constructor, which assigns a new rs/gui/c instance directly to SubstanceSkin.buttonShaper.
The class extends Substance ClassicButtonShaper and overrides getCornerRadius(AbstractButton,float).
The override always returns 0.0f regardless of button or requested radius, forcing square/zero-radius button geometry for the skin.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the custom Substance button shaper that forces zero corner radius.
